title: The Tiger's Big Championship Kick
idea: Young street-smart tiger cub Tomi dreams of joining the legendary capital city football club. When the squad's star striker gets food poisoning from spicy street dumplings the night before the decisive October showdown, the desperate coach spots Tomi dazzling crowds by juggling mangoes at a night market and drafts him. With city pride on the line against their fierce coastal rivals, Tomi must unite a bickering team, only to discover the rival team's unstoppable captain is his own long-lost older brother.
visual: A vibrant tropical metropolis illuminated by glowing evening stadium floodlights, filled with animated animal fans cheering wildly from towering stands. In the center, a plucky young tiger cub dressed in a bright orange and white jersey expertly balances a soccer ball on his nose with a determined grin.
